flow_ref: User story (not in any OCMS flow deck)
code_summary: ocmsadminui pages/Report/lists/{ReportList.tsx,ReportListWorkOrder.tsx} (Workorder Reports tab commented out, no data), pages/Report/index.tsx, utils/models/Fapi.d.ts, utils/Meta/System.ts (WARRANT_SETTLE_DATE is only a menu meta entry). ocmsadminapi api-authorization.properties. ocmsadminprivateapi src/main/resources/cron-schedules-prod.properties. No criteria matrix, parameter, job, or work order generator in the six repos
note: The story status is blank in stories.json (requirement not given), so it is traced normally. The story asks for a criteria matrix (number of IDs per work order, number of outstanding warrants, WA issue date, offence type) used to select IDs for the monthly work order so it can be generated automatically. There is no code: grep workorder, work_order, matrix, selection criteria across the six repos only finds the commented-out 'Workorder Reports' tab with no resource (ReportList.tsx:147-201; ReportListWorkOrder.tsx:48), with columns notice_no, vehicle_no, ref_num unrelated to a matrix. There is no monthly work order cron in cron-schedules-prod.properties, no matrix parameter/entity, and WARRANT_SETTLE_DATE in utils/Meta/System.ts:163-166 is only a menu entry with no page or backend. No relevant maintenance ticket.
recommendation: No code for the criteria matrix or the monthly work order generator; do not claim as done

steps.step: The Tagging officer maintains the ID selection criteria matrix in OCMS
steps.detail: There is no page, parameter or entity for a criteria matrix. The only warrant-flavoured item in the System Admin menu is WARRANT_SETTLE_DATE (System.ts:163-166), just a menu meta entry with no page or backend in any repo. The parameter module in ocmsadminapi/crud/ocmsizdb/parameter is a generic parameter table with no work-order-related key. case-insensitive grep across the six repos (warrant, workorder, work_order, tagging, visit, enforcement, bailiff, service provider, matrix) finds no entity, controller, cron, or service for this feature.

steps.step: The matrix holds the number of IDs to select for each work order
steps.detail: There is no field or configuration for the number of IDs per work order. The Workorder Reports tab (ReportListWorkOrder.tsx:48) is just an empty grid with no resource.

steps.step: The matrix holds the criteria number of outstanding warrants, WA issue date and offence type
steps.detail: No criteria are stored. warrant_issue_date is only a field in the type Iwarrantofarrest (Iwarrantofarrest.d.ts:1-40) and no selection logic reads it. Offence type (offencerulecode) exists as notice master data in ocmsadminapi but is not linked to any work order selection.

steps.step: OCMS selects IDs for the monthly work order based on the matrix
steps.detail: There is no monthly cron/job that selects IDs. cron-schedules-prod.properties has no work order or WA entry. No service reads a matrix and selects IDs.

steps.step: The work order is generated automatically by OCMS according to the criteria
steps.detail: There is no work order generator (file, report or interface to the service provider). There is only the commented-out Workorder Reports tab (ReportList.tsx:147-201), with no resource, and Fapi.d.ts:307 is only a comment reports/workorder/excel with no controller. Integration with the service provider cannot be verified from the repo.
